annotations.title: Find eSIM plans for a destination

description: Use this when someone needs mobile data for a trip to ONE country or wants a regional pass (Europe, Asia, Balkans, Global…). Returns the GlobalPass travel eSIM plans on sale there: data, validity, final price, networks and a link to buy each plan. Data only: no calls or SMS. For a route through several countries call plan_trip instead.

currency.description: Currency for prices. Defaults to PLN for Polish and EUR otherwise; use USD for dollar cards.

data_gb.description: Gigabytes needed for the whole stay, if known.

days.description: Length of the stay in days, if known.

destination.description: A country or region as the traveller says it, in English, Polish or Russian, or an ISO code: "Turkey", "Egipt", "ОАЭ", "Europe", "TR".

language.description: The traveller's language for names and for the pages the links open: en, pl or ru.

name: search_plans
title: Find eSIM plans for a destination
